l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question:
设 $f(x)$ 在点 $x_0$ 处可导， $a_n < x_0 < b_n$ 且 $\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = \lim_{n \to \infty} b_n = x_0$ . 证明：

\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}).

steps.text: 分析 由极限的定义，只需证明 $\forall \varepsilon > 0$ ， $\exists K > 0$ ，当 $n \geqslant K$ 时，有 $\left|\frac{f(b_n) - f(a_n)}{b_n - a_n} - f'(x_0)\right| < \varepsilon$ ；也可利用 $f'(x)$ 的定义得到 $f(x)$ 在 $x_0$ 附近的局部表达式，再计算极限 $\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{f(b_n) - f(a_n)}{b_n - a_n}$ .

方法1 因为 $f(x)$ 在点 $x_0$ 处可导， $\forall \varepsilon > 0$ ， $\exists \delta > 0$ ，当 $0 < |x - x_0| < \delta$ 时，有

\left| \frac {f (x) - f \left(x _ {0}\right)}{x - x _ {0}} - f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right) \right| <   \varepsilon .

又 $\lim_{n\to \infty}a_n = \lim_{n\to \infty}b_n = x_0$ ，对上面选定的 $\delta$ ， $\exists K > 0$ ，使对于所有 $n\geqslant K$ ，有 $\left|a_n - x_0\right| <   \delta$ 和 $\left|b_n - x_0\right| <   \delta$ ，从而

\left| \frac {f (a _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{a _ {n} - x _ {0}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| <   \varepsilon , \quad \left| \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{b _ {n} - x _ {0}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| <   \varepsilon .\tag{①}

但

\begin{array}{r l} & {\left| f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n}) - (b _ {n} - a _ {n}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right|} \\ & {= \left| \left[ f (b _ {n}) - f (x _ {0}) - (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right] - \left[ f (a _ {n}) - f (x _ {0}) - (a _ {n} - x _ {0}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right] \right|} \\ & {\leqslant \left| f (b _ {n}) - f (x _ {0}) - (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| + \left| f (a _ {n}) - f (x _ {0}) - (a _ {n} - x _ {0}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right|} \\ & {\leqslant \varepsilon \left| b _ {n} - x _ {0} \right| + \varepsilon \left| a _ {n} - x _ {0} \right| = \varepsilon (b _ {n} - a _ {n}).} \end{array}

式中的倒数第二步是从①式推出的，而最后一步从 $a_{n} < x_{0} < b_{n}$ 推知.

所以

\left| \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| <   \varepsilon ,

由极限的定义知

\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = f ^ {\prime} \left(x _ {0}\right).

方法2 记 $\lambda = f'(x_0)$ ，即 $\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{f(x_0 + \Delta x) - f(x_0)}{\Delta x} = \lambda$ ，则有

f (x _ {0} + \Delta x) = f (x _ {0}) + \lambda \Delta x + o (\Delta x),

于是有

\begin{array}{l} f (a _ {n}) = f (x _ {0}) + \lambda (a _ {n} - x _ {0}) + o (a _ {n} - x _ {0}), \\ f (b _ {n}) = f (x _ {0}) + \lambda (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) + o (b _ {n} - x _ {0}). \end{array}

考虑

\frac {o \left(b _ {n} - x _ {0}\right) + o \left(a _ {n} - x _ {0}\right)}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = \frac {o \left(b _ {n} - x _ {0}\right)}{b _ {n} - x _ {0}} \cdot \frac {b _ {n} - x _ {0}}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} + \frac {o \left(a _ {n} - x _ {0}\right)}{a _ {n} - x _ {0}} \cdot \frac {a _ {n} - x _ {0}}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}},

因 $\left|\frac{a_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n}\right| < 1, \left|\frac{b_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n}\right| < 1$ ，则

\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {o (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) + o (a _ {n} - x _ {0})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = 0,

即

o (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) + o (a _ {n} - x _ {0}) = o (b _ {n} - a _ {n}).

这时有

因此

f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n}) = \lambda (b _ {n} - a _ {n}) + o (b _ {n} - x _ {0}) + o (a _ {n} - x _ {0}) = \lambda (b _ {n} - a _ {n}) + o (b _ {n} - a _ {n}),

\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = \lambda = f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}).

方法3 因为 $\frac{f(b_n) - f(a_n)}{b_n - a_n} = \frac{b_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n} \cdot \frac{f(b_n) - f(x_0)}{b_n - x_0} - \frac{a_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n} \cdot \frac{f(a_n) - f(x_0)}{a_n - x_0}$ , 记 $\frac{b_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n} = \lambda_n$ ，则 $\frac{a_n - x_0}{b_n - a_n} = \lambda_n - 1$ ，且 $0 < \lambda_n < 1, 0 < 1 - \lambda_n < 1$ ，有

\frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = \lambda_ {n} \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{b _ {n} - x _ {0}} + (1 - \lambda_ {n}) \frac {f (a _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{a _ {n} - x _ {0}}.

又

则

f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) = \lambda_ {n} f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) + (1 - \lambda_ {n}) f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}),

\begin{array}{l}\left| \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| \leqslant\\\lambda_ {n} \left| \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{b _ {n} - x _ {0}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right| + (1 - \lambda_ {n}) \left| \frac {f (a _ {n}) - f (x _ {0})}{a _ {n} - x _ {0}} - f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}) \right|\rightarrow 0 (n \rightarrow \infty).\end{array}

所以

\lim _ {n \rightarrow \infty} \frac {f (b _ {n}) - f (a _ {n})}{b _ {n} - a _ {n}} = f ^ {\prime} (x _ {0}).
